name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JULY 10, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Encinitas Library Japan Festival 10-Year Celebration
4B.
Presentation of Proclamation declaring Parks and Recreation Month – “Parks Make Life Better”
4C.
Recognition of Bob and Mimi Gattinella of the Encinitas Chamber of Commerce
4D.
Presentation by SANDAG Executive Director Hasan Ikhrata regarding SANDAG’s Big Vision and 5 Big Moves for the San Diego Forward: The 2021 Regional Plan Update
4C.
Recognition of Bob and Mimi Gattinella of the Encinitas Chamber of Commerce
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
08A.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 12, 2019 Special Meeting, June 12, 2019 Regular Meeting, June 19, 2019 Special Meeting-Closed Session, June 19, 2019 Special Meeting, and June 19, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-07-10 Item 08A Minutes
08B.
Amendment to the Contract with the County of San Diego for Advanced Life Support First Responder Services in County Service Area 17. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
1) Approve Contract No. 558294 Amendment 1 with the County of San Diego Department of Purchasing and Contracting to extend Advanced Life Support First Responder Services in County Service Area 17 in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment to the Contract on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2019-07-10 Item 08B Amendment to Contract with County of San Diego for Advanced Life Support CSA-17
08C.
B Street Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS18G). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Milligan
Approve the plans, specifications and authorize advertisement of the B Street Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS18G).
2019-07-10 Item 08C B Street Sidewalks -Design Approval Agenda Report
08D.
2018 State Homeland Security Grant in the amount of $37,861 for the Purchase of 800 MHz Replacement Radios. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Accept $37,861 in federal funds from a 2018 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) grant awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase of 800 MHz radios; and 2) Authorize the Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit the required California Governor's Office of Emergency Services Fiscal Year 2018 Grant Assurances.
2019-07-10 Item 08D 2018 State Homeland Security Grant Acceptance
08E.
Grant application for the California Housing and Community Development (HCD) SB-2 Planning Grants Program (Grant). Contact Person: Housing Consultant Schwarm
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-58 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Authorizing Application for, and receipt of, SB 2 Planning Grants Program Funds” and authorizing the City Manager to enter into, execute and deliver a State of California Agreement for the amount of $310,000.
2019-07-10 Item 08E SB-2 Planning Grant Authorization
08F.
Senior Center ADA Improvements Project (CF18A). Contact Person: Association Civil Engineer Widelski
Approve the plans, specifications and authorize advertisement of the Senior Center ADA Improvements Project (CF18A).
2019-07-10 Item 08F Senior Center ADA-Design Approval
08G.
Adoption of Ordinance 2019-07 establishing a new speed limit of 20 miles per hour on Neptune Avenue. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt Ordinance 2019-07 entitled “an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on Neptune Avenue.”
2019-07-10 Item 08G Adoption of Ordinance 2019-07 Neptune Speed Limit
08H.
Ratify the legislative position letters in support to a proposed bill for United States Congress House of Representatives Bill 2995: Spent Fuel Prioritization Act of 2019. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letter in support of the Spent Fuel Prioritization Act of 2019 as signed by Councilmember Kranz on behalf of Mayor Blakespear.
2019-07-10 Item 08H Legislative Position Letter Spent Fuel Prioritizaton Act of 2019
08I.
Ratify the legislative position letters in opposition to AB 56 (Garcia), AB 516 (Chiu) and AB 1763 (Chiu). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letters in opposition to AB 56 (Garcia), AB 516 (Chiu) and AB 1763 (Chiu) signed by the Mayor.
2019-07-10 Item 08I Legislative Position Letters for AB 56, 516, 1763
08J.
Request by San Dieguito Heritage Museum, Inc. (SOHM), to amend the Lease Agreement to operate the Heritage Museum dated May 16, 2003 (the Lease Agreement), to add a farmer’s market as an authorized use. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Direct staff to return to Council with an amendment to the Lease Agreement with SOHM to add a farmer's market as an authorized use, for consideration and possible approval, only if and subsequent to, SOHM obtaining all required entitlements.
2019-07-10 Item 08J San Dieguito Heritage Museum - Farmers Market amended
08K.
Legislative position letter in support of SB 5 (Beal/McGuire/Portantino). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letter in support of SB 5 signed by Councilmember Kranz in the Mayor’s absence.
2019-07-10 Item 08K Legislative Position Letter for SB 5
08L.
Two-Year Management Services Agreements between the City and: Encinitas 101 MainStreet Association, Leucadia 101 MainStreet Association, Cardiff 101 MainStreet Association and the Encinitas Chamber of Commerce. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
1) Two-year management services agreement with Encinitas 101 MainStreet Association in the amount of $20,000 per fiscal year; 2) Two-year management services agreement with Leucadia 101 MainStreet Association in the amount of $30,000 per fiscal year; 3) Two-year management services agreement with Cardiff 101 MainStreet Association in the amount 0of $20,000 per fiscal year; and 4) Two-year management services agreement with Encinitas Chamber of Commerce in the amount 0of $20,000 per fiscal year.
2019-07-10 Item 08L Chamber and MainStreet Associations Agreements
08M.
Agreement with LC Paving and Sealing Inc. for the Downtown Cardiff Accessibility Improvements Project (CS18H). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Milligan
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute any and all change orders to the existing construction contract with LC Paving and Sealing, Inc. related to the Downtown Cardiff Accessibility Improvements project, for a total additional project expenditure of up to $24,455, increasing the total construction cost to an amount not to exceed $88,479.
2019-07-10 Item 08M LC Paving and Sealing Agreement
08N.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2019-07-10 Item 08N Mobility and Grant Report
08O.
Request to waive rental and attendant fees for the Silver Age Yoga Program at the Encinitas Library Community Room.
Approve waiving rental and staffing fees for Silver Age Yoga to offer senior yoga classes at the Encinitas Library Community Room two (2) days a week for a period of one (1) year.
2019-07-10 Item 08O Silver Age Yoga Waiving of Fees
08P.
Authorization to Purchase Fleet Vehicle, Equipment, and Fire Apparatus Due for Replacement in Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Authorize the purchase of one vehicle in accordance with the attached quotes, for an amount not to exceed $46,500, plus upfitting costs not to exceed $7,700, for a total amount of $54,200; 2) Authorize the purchase of one piece of equipment in accordance with the attached quotes, for an amount not-to-exceed $52,000; 3) Authorize the purchase of a Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper Fire Engine in accordance with the attached quote, for an amount not to exceed $800,000, as the recommended replacement for a 2003 American LaFrance Pumper (VM 214); 4) Authorize staff to pre-pay for the purchase of the fire engine within 15 days of the issuance of the Purchase Order; 5) Authorize staff to seek long-term financing for the Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper Fire Engine from Pinnacle Public Finance, on a negotiated basis, and to return to Council with the financing proposal and related documentation for Council approval; and 6) Adopt Resolution 2019-59, titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas Declaring its Intent to issue Tax-Exempt Financing to be Used to Reimburse the City of Qualified Expenditures Prior to the Issuance of Such Financing."
2019-07-10 Item 08P FY20 Fleet Replacement
08Q.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-06, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 - Leaf Blower Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Ordinance 2019-06 entitled " An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California Adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 - Leaf Blower Ordinance."
2019-07-10 Item 08Q Leaf Blower Ordinance Adoption
08R.
Authorize approval of annual software maintenance renewals with Cloudflare, Complete Paperless Solutions (CPS), Central Square Technologies, and Planet Bids for FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-21. Contact Person: IT Project Manager Salmon
1) Authorize the annual software maintenance renewal for Cloudflare in an amount not to exceed $15,500 in FY 2019-20 and an anticipated amount not to exceed $16,275 in FY 2020-21, for a total amount not to exceed $62,833; 2) Authorize the annual software maintenance renewal for Complete Paperless Solutions in an amount not to exceed $13,603 in FY 2019-20 and an anticipated amount not to exceed$13,603 in FY 2020-21, for a total amount not to exceed $128,163; 3) Authorize the annual software maintenance renewal for Central Square Technologies in an amount not to exceed $63,284 in FY 2019-20 and an anticipated amount not to exceed$30,000 in FY 2020-21, for a total amount not to exceed $2,691,001; and 4) Authorize the annual software maintenance renewal for Planet Bids in an amount not to exceed $12,815 in FY 2019-20 and an anticipated amount not to exceed $13,200 in FY 2020-21, for a total amount not to exceed $65,687.
2019-07-10 Item 08R Authorize approval of annual software maintenance renewals
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
AT THE REQUEST OF THE APPLICANT, THE PUBLIC HEARING LISTED AS ITEM 10A IS BEING CONTINUED TO THE SEPTEMBER 18, 2019 CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Major Use Permit, Design Review Permit, and Coastal Development Permit request to allow the reface of an existing hotel, adding square-footage to the lobby, addition of alcohol service, hotel bar, roof deck pool and bar area, parking lot and landscaping improvements, and new valet parking. CASE NUMBER: 15-285 MUP/DR/CDP; APPLICANT: 101 Hotel, Inc.; APPELLANT: Donald McPherson; LOCATION: 186 North Coast Highway 101 (APN: 256-392-11). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mierau
AT THE REQUEST OF THE APPLICANT, THIS PUBLIC HEARING IS BEING CONTINUED TO THE SEPTEMBER 18, 2019 CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
Deny the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2019-59 affirming the decision of the Planning Commission.

2019-07-10 Item 10A Appeal of 101 Portofino Hotel Project - Attachment 7

Public hearing regarding the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-08, to adopt the modification suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2019-04, which amended three Specific Plans, Municipal and Zoning Codes, and the Local Coastal Program to clarify provisions to implement the new General Plan Land Use designation and development standards. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-08 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting the Modification Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2019-04, Amending the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan.”
2019-07-10 Item 10B Housing Element Coastal Commission Modification
10C.
Amendment No. 4 to Agreement for City Attorney?s Professional Services. Contact Person: Council Subcommittee Members Deputy Mayor Hubbard and Council Member Mosca
Approve Addendum No.4 to the Agreement for City Attorney?s Professional Services amending Section 4.0 Services and Duties, to be effective July 1, 2019.
2019-07-10 Item 10C Amendment 4 to City Attorney Contract
08Q.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-06, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 - Leaf Blower Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Ordinance 2019-06 entitled " An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California Adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 - Leaf Blower Ordinance."
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Information report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM

CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 21, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
